Forward-in-time migration matrix conversion

FitMigMatC.Rd

Computes the forward-in-time migration matrix associated with a given backwards-in-time migration matrix, coalescent rate and time scale

Usage

FitMigMatC(bit_mm, coal_rate)

Arguments

bit_mm

NumericMatrix Backward-in-time migration matrix

coal_rate

NumericVector Coalescent rates

Value

NumericMatrix Forward-in-time migration matrix
